data_code: import numpy as np; import pandas as pd; df['촉매로트_그룹'] = df['촉매로트'].map({'FC-2602':'Old', 'FC-2603':'Old', 'FC-2604':'Old', 'FC-2605':'Old', 'FC-2606':'New', 'FC-2607':'New', 'FC-2608':'New'}); bins = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25); df['bin_idx'] = np.digitize(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins) - 1; df['bin_left'] = df['bin_idx'].apply(lambda i: bins[i] if 0 <= i < len(bins)-1 else np.nan); df['bin_right'] = df['bin_idx'].apply(lambda i: bins[i+1] if 0 <= i < len(bins)-1 else np.nan); grp = df.groupby(['촉매로트_그룹', 'bin_left', 'bin_right']); agg_df = grp.agg(cnt=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'size'), mean_yield=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'mean')).reset_index(); agg_df['mid'] = (agg_df['bin_left'] + agg_df['bin_right']) / 2; pts = []; for _, r in agg_df.iterrows(): pts.append({'체류시간_bin_mid': r['mid'], 'CNT수율_mean': r['mean_yield'], '촉매로트_그룹': r['촉매로트_그룹'], 'bin_n': int(r['cnt'])}); new_df = pd.DataFrame(pts); df.drop(columns=df.columns, inplace=True); df_new_cols = list(new_df.columns); for c in df_new_cols: df[c] = new_df[c].values
